g.text: When minute hand turns 360°, hour hand
• Emerald Face: Calibrated clock dial with 6° ticks.

Seat the geared clock frame into its
wedges into their labeled radial lid
bays; any missing wedge leaves an
instantly empty bay. Snap lid shut.
